status: implementation candidate; browser, Android and commercial balance validation pending
visualPolicy: Reuse the existing board-special body, fruit and direction composition from src/SpecialTileArt.ts; no copied game art or newly generated raster.
stableIdPolicy: Keep internal IDs, unlock levels, prices, introduced and trialUsed records. User-facing names and roles follow tools-v2 only. Previous tool images remain historical source artifacts.
scope: Four creators retain the normal piece kind and add one board special without activation, score, collection, obstacle damage or RNG. Gloves retain the existing real swap/cascade behavior. Old tools-v1 rounds keep their profile and ordinary play; new tools become available only in a new tools-v2 round.
